Our story 💞

First sight 👀

I saw you in class and you looked so innocent. I liked you right away, and I kept walking behind you after class (shh!).

Computer lab and library 💻

I saw you closely for the first time in the computer lab. Then in the library you sat with your friend, and that's where I first heard your voice, when you asked me to plug in your laptop charger.

Infinity Corridor ✨

Our first real conversation. Then came your birthday, the bunked maths class, and my wish.

Library buddies 📚

You asked 'tum library jaate ho?' and said 'kal se mujhe bhi bula lena'. We studied at Central Library, and at night in the study room, with me helping you.

Group Gumnam 😎

After mid-sems, our group of 5-6 became 'Gumnam' on WhatsApp. I sat a little apart on purpose so you'd find a moment to come talk to me.

Tinkerer's Lab ⚡

Our electronics project turned into a very long conversation, and my feelings got a little too strong for you.

Sameer Hills road 🌙

Mosquito bites, endless talking, and I wished the moment would never end. Then you rested your head on my shoulder, and I still remember your perfume.

The Maggie mix-up 🍜

On your train I tried ordering your favourite Maggie, but I put the last station as the address. I felt so bad. I meant well, baby!

Didi's wedding 👗

I picked my outfit by asking you, because I wanted to wear what you liked.

31st December 💍

I asked you to be my girlfriend late at night, and you gave me a mixed sign. Back at college, outside the Energy Science building, I came with jhumke and you finally said yes.

Campus nights 🌃

Late walks, me teaching you mathematical physics, and our quiet moments at Energy Science and VMCC.

Marine Drive 🍔

Our Valentine's Day date: sitting together, sharing a burger, and being exactly where we wanted to be.

Now: long distance 📱

Miles apart, but we still meet and talk whenever we can. Soon, baby, soon.

Only Us 💞

A surprise for you 💌

Meri Chammakchallo,

Happy Birthday, baby! 🎂

Pehli baar jab tumhe class mein dekha tha, tum itni innocent lagi thi ki bas pasand aa gayi. Class ke baad tumhare peeche peeche chalta tha, aur tumhe pata bhi nahi tha 😂

Laptop charger lagane ko tumne kaha tha, wahi pehli baar tumhari awaaz suni. Phir Infinity Corridor, birthday wish ke liye bunk ki hui maths class, library, study room aur Gumnam group. Main jaanbujhkar sabse alag baithta tha taaki tum mere paas aao, aur tum aati thi.

Sameer Hills ke raste pe machhar katte rahe, par main chahta tha ki wo moment kabhi khatam na ho. Jab tumne mere kandhe pe sar rakha, tumhare baalon ki khushboo aur tumhara perfume... main aaj bhi wo moment bhoola nahi hoon. Mujhe achhe se yaad hai, jab koi aur wo perfume lagata hai toh main chidh jata hoon, ye meri baby ka hai 😤

Train mein tumhare liye Maggie order ki thi aur address last station ka daal diya. Us din bohot bura laga, par tumhari fikar sachchi thi. Didi ki shaadi mein bhi tumhari pasand ki dress pehni, kyunki tum meri pasand ho.

Mujhe tum sabse zyada pyaari lagti ho jab tum mujhse gussa hoti ho aur jab tum hasti ho. Baaki sabse tum rude hoti ho, aur mujhse sabse pyaar se, ye baat mujhe bohot special feel karwati hai. Aur off-white dress mein toh words khatam.

Door hain abhi, par dil se bilkul paas. Tumhare saath physics bhi easy lagti thi, aur zindagi bhi. Jab tak Maggie, dahi jalebi aur tum ho, main yahin hoon.

Love you so much, baby ❤️
Forever yours,
Billo
